## Legibility and witnesses

Current assessment covers the scans described below; individual completion times are recorded in progress.log. The title on 002 is clear apart from its leading numeral/letter. The algebra pages contain overlapping insertions, cancellations and small subscripts. Their weakest readings are crowded or crossed symbols, isolated marks and the joined initials at the foot of 004. The final text preserves alternatives at those loci. Separate local cancellations are retained even inside whole-page cancellation.

The completed comparisons show that C often preserves cancelled, inserted and marginal material that H omits. H also supplies punctuation absent from the checked ink. C nevertheless requires corrections, including resolved doubt marks and newly retained marks. The change totals count individual recorded loci, including punctuation and placement; they do not measure a word error rate. The remaining-doubts tables identify the readings to trust least. The requested 24-scan sequence is complete; the final scan026 commit is recorded at 2026-11-21 10:13:31 UTC (see the completion paragraphs below).

Scan 005 has more open prose spacing, with very compressed letter joins in a few words. The accents and literal running-text equals sign are resolved. Its contracted ending, barred-Q alphabet, and small detached marks remain the least secure loci on that page; the marks are retained without a settled function or hand attribution.

Scan006 has two opposed writing layers and long crossing strokes. Crowded exponents, primes and overwritten signs remain its weakest readings. Full crop bounds resolved two predecessor letters; the raised-2 cancellation state and one prose comma remain explicit doubts. Extra fraction-rule strokes are drawn.

Scan007 has largely clear upright main writing. Its dense opening deletion and pale marginal note remain unreadable or qualified. The three independent main-text readings agree; the consolidated text adds the visible paired cancellation geometry.

Scan008 has clear main arithmetic text with several densely crossed predecessors and pale additions. Six original C doubts remain, while the final cancelled q and its raised entry are resolved. The capital Car, shared frame/rule geometry, and detached marks are preserved. Tiny residual shapes and the pale primed letter remain the least secure material. H supplies no text for this page.

Scan010 is a drawing sheet with clear major outlines, crossings, grouping curves and labels. Its small vertex fills, overdrawn lower disk, pale residual traces and angular foot marks are less secure. The five original C doubt-table rows remain qualified. Newly recovered fragments are reproduced graphically; uncertainty about their role or surface origin stays explicit in the record. H supplies a description, so this page contributes no H text-collation rows.
